cases.reprLiteral: expected_hohmann_maneuver = "Number of impulses: 2, Total cost: 3.060548 km / s"

totalDeltaV.rationale: half a unit in the last decimal place hapsira's repr() prints: six decimals of km/s resolve 1e-6 km/s = 1 mm/s, so the honest gate is +/- 0.5 mm/s = 5e-4 m/s. Nothing tighter is assertable about a number that reached us through a formatted string.

cases.note: hapsira departs from the orbit's actual periapsis STATE: dv_a = sqrt(2k/r_i - k/a_trans) - v_i, with v_i the true periapsis speed. Our computeHohmannTransfer assumes a CIRCULAR departure and the JSON surface gives the caller no way to say otherwise — which is exactly graph task modules-maneuver-hohmann-departure-speed.
